test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following autobiographies is NOT correctly matched with the concerned cricketer?

options.text: Playing it My Way – VVS Laxman
The Test of My Life: From Cricket to Cancer and Back – Yuvraj Singh
Straight from the Heart – Kapil Dev

solution:
The correct answer is __**Playing it My Way – VVS Laxman**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The autobiography** "Playing it My Way" is incorrectly matched.**
 
• It is written by** Sachin Tendulkar, not VVS Laxman.**
 
• The other books are correctly matched with the respective cricketers.
